# fortiappseccloud_waf_threshold_detection

Configures threshold detection for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/threshold_detection`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_threshold_detection` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_threshold_detection`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_threshold_detection" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status                 = true
    action                 = "block_period"
    challenge              = "RBE"
    crawler                = false
    vulnerability_scan     = true
    slow_attack            = false
    content_scraping       = false
    credential_brute_force = true
    request_url            = "/login"
    occurrence             = 10
    range                  = 60

    exception_list {
      item {
        concatenate_type = "AND"
        match_target     = "COOKIE"
        operator         = "REGEXP_MATCH"
        value_name       = "session_id"
        value_check      = true
        value            = "terraform-matrix"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Configuration Notes

- Credential brute-force detection requires `request_url`. Exception IP values must use an address or address range accepted by FortiAppSec Cloud.

## Argument Reference

- `ep_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — Application endpoint ID. Import uses this exact value and it must contain a non-whitespace character.
- `template` (Required) — Whether effective configuration is inherited from the attached template.
- `configs` (Block) — Required when `template = false` and forbidden when `template = true`. State keeps this block null when template inheritance is enabled.
  - `action` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Action. One of `alert`, `alert_deny`, `block_period`, `deny_no_log`. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `challenge` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Challenge. One of `CAPTCHA`, `RBE`, `disable`. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `content_scraping` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Content scraping for threshold detection. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `crawler` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Crawler for threshold detection. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `credential_brute_force` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Credential brute force for threshold detection. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `occurrence` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Occurrence. Between 1 and 100. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `range` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Range. Between 1 and 60. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `request_url` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Request url. At most 127 UTF-8 characters. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `slow_attack` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Slow attack for threshold detection. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `status` (Optional, Computed) — Enables or disables threshold detection. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `vulnerability_scan` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Vulnerability scan for threshold detection. Omission preserves the current value.
  - Collection ownership — Each block below contains ordered `item` blocks. Omitting a collection block preserves the complete raw remote array and keeps the block null in state. A present empty block sends `[]`. A present block with items replaces the complete array in Terraform order.
    - `exception_list` (Optional Block, at most 128 items) — Owns the ordered `exception_list.item` blocks.
      - `exception_list.item.concatenate_type` (Required, one of `AND`, `OR`) — Concatenate type.
      - `exception_list.item.ip_range` (Optional, Computed) — Ip range.
      - `exception_list.item.match_target` (Required, one of `CLIENT_IP`, `COOKIE`, `FULL_URL`, `HOST`, `PARAMETER`, `URI`) — Match target.
      - `exception_list.item.operator` (Required, one of `EQ`, `NE`, `REGEXP_MATCH`, `STRING_MATCH`) — Operator.
      - `exception_list.item.value` (Optional, Computed) — Parameter value.
      - `exception_list.item.value_check` (Optional, Computed) — Value check. Defaults to `false` for a newly configured item.
      - `exception_list.item.value_name` (Optional, Computed) — Value name.

The wire-only `idx` field is never exposed. The provider regenerates sequential one-based indices independently for each list, validates imported or owned response indices, and sorts state by `idx`. Unknown nested item keys fail closed for owned and imported arrays; omitted top-level collection wrappers remain opaque and are preserved unchanged.


## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_threshold_detection.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
